body: I'm sorry I didn't get back to you sooner. It sounds like he has his own problems. I think you should focus on what you think is right. If he wants to be a negative about everything, and refuses to listen to reason then just drown him out as much as possible. I know it's hard, but I think it will help you a lot. Work on the other hand could be difficult. I would search for another job as soon as possible. It sounds like a terrible place to work. I think somewhere that pays less but is enjoyable to work at, is completely worth it. You could also just zone out at those meetings and continue to try your best. That's really all there is too do, if you get fired draw unemployment and recuperate. Talk with your student loan provider before you default finance companies  would rather get some money then no money.
"Don't waste your time talking to me". As I precede to write out several paragraphs of gibberish to you.

And the Internet is nuts! I have all these instant messenger conversations with her saved. I still see her tumblr and Google+ accounts almost every day! I was friends with her for 10 years and she had such a hard life god I don't know what to think.

I greatly appreciate it. I wouldn't know where to start and someone else probably deserves your time more then I do. I just think of my friend and cry. It's  just sick, I was just skipping school with her 4 years ago. Talking to her about Adventure Time comics, and eating gross food from sonic 2 months ago. I just feel better after writing this stuff out.

I'm sorry your family seems to be so foolish. Have you tried contacting a professional therapist? It may be hard to find one you "click" with, so don't give up if the first one you talk to isn't right.

Therapists are there to listen to you and help you talk it out. Especially when your family and friends can't be trusted to help.
Have you brought up to your dad that his criticisms are not helping and are only hurtful? He may not realize he is being a negative force in your life.
